question: How should the beloved goddess be asked to meditate on the letter va?
premises: Meditation can proceed by different methods.
The letter va is the object of contemplation.
The goddess is addressed as beautiful-limbed and beloved.
inference: The practitioner is instructed to meditate on the letter va through varied methods of contemplation.
plain_english: O beautiful-limbed beloved, meditate on the letter va through different methods of meditation.
